title: A Cyber Range Evaluation of Autonomous Network Incident Response Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.16541v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We test the performance of agents for automated network intrusion response in a cyber range intended for human operator training. The range implements an emulated networking environment with a variable network topology, red-team emulation and simulated user agents. The goal of the defensive agents is to prevent hosts in the network from being accessed by the red-team agent, while minimizing the availability costs induced from defensive measures. Alerts are generated using a SIEM platform and mapped to a data modeling language used by the agents. We test a combination of heuristic agents and policies learned using reinforcement learning. The learned policies are optimized to minimize the combined cost using a cyber attack simulator modeling the network. translated_title: 自主网络事件响应代理的网络靶场评估
translated_abstract: 我们在一个专为人机操作员训练设计的网络靶场中，测试了用于自动化网络入侵响应的代理的性能。该靶场实现了一个仿真的网络环境，具有可变的网络拓扑、红队攻击模拟以及模拟用户代理。防御代理的目标是防止网络中的主机被红队代理访问，同时最小化防御措施所带来的可用性成本。告警通过SIEM平台生成，并映射为代理所使用的数据建模语言。我们测试了启发式代理与通过强化学习习得策略的组合。学习到的策略通过一个对网络进行建模的网络攻击模拟器进行优化，以最小化综合成本。我们发现，强化学习代理在防御系统方面总体上比启发式策略更有效率，且其性能高度依赖于红队的策略（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文在网络靶场环境中评估了自主网络事件响应代理，发现基于强化学习的代理在防御网络入侵方面总体上优于启发式策略，且性能表现高度依赖于红队的攻击策略。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates autonomous network incident response agents in a cyber range, finding that reinforcement learning agents are overall more efficient at defending systems than heuristic policies, with performance highly dependent on the red team's policy.
